The Maruti WagonR was India's best-selling car in October, with 23,747 units. But the facelifted Brezza jumped 86% to 22,436 and finished just 1,311 behind.

October's top 5: WagonR 23,747, Brezza 22,436, Tata Nexon 21,966, Baleno 20,919, Dzire 20,649. Maruti holds 7 of the top 10 spots, and 8 of the 10 models grew year on year.
